description: Deterministic modality variants of the frozen 60 WorldSense videos (scripts/create_modality_variants.py). video_subtitle reuses the video_only file.

commands.video_only: ffmpeg -nostdin -v error -i INPUT -map 0:v:0 -c:v copy -an -map_metadata -1 -map_chapters -1 -sn -dn -fflags +bitexact -flags:v +bitexact -f mp4 OUTPUT
commands.audio_only: ffmpeg -nostdin -v error -i INPUT -map 0:a:0 -c:a copy -vn -map_metadata -1 -map_chapters -1 -sn -dn -fflags +bitexact -flags:a +bitexact -f ipod OUTPUT
